chunks: Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from al-Husayn ibn Hammad said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who prostrates on pebbles, he said: 'He raises his head until he is able (to do so properly).'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they prostrate on pebbles or an uneven surface during prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the practical mechanics of *sujud* on uneven surfaces like pebbles, instructing the worshipper to raise their head until they can firmly establish themselves in prostration. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that while the physical surface must be permissible, the validity of the act depends on achieving a stable and dignified posture, reflecting the balance between ritual precision and practical ease in worship.
